title: From Causal Plausibility to Causal Reliability: Evaluating LLMs as Calibrated Direct Causal-Edge Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2608.23660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to provide prior causal knowledge for structural causal discovery, yet whether their direct-edge judgments and confidence can be trusted remains unclear. We systematically evaluate 12 instruction-tuned open-weight models across six benchmark causal graphs, five prompting strategies, and four confidence sources: verbalized, logit-based, cross-prompt agreement, and cross-model agreement. Under our language-only pairwise protocol, our evaluation yields three key findings. (i) LLM-based causal judgments are strongly recall-dominant: models predict overly dense graphs with many false-positive edges, while prompting mainly shifts the precision-recall trade-off rather than resolving overprediction. Gains from model scale diminish on the largest graphs and do not eliminate miscalibration. (ii) LLMs often capture causal relatedness without reliably identifying directness or orientation. Relativ

translated_title: 从因果合理性到因果可靠性：评估大型语言模型作为校准的直接因果边分类器
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于为结构因果发现提供先验因果知识，然而其直接边判断和置信度是否值得信赖仍不清楚。我们系统评估了12个指令微调的开源模型，涵盖六个基准因果图、五种提示策略和四种置信度来源：言语化、基于logit、跨提示一致性和跨模型一致性。在我们的仅语言配对协议下，评估得出三个关键发现：（i）基于LLM的因果判断强烈偏向召回主导：模型预测出过度密集的图，包含许多假正边，而提示主要改变精确率-召回率权衡，而非解决过度预测问题。模型规模带来的增益在最大图上减弱，且未消除校准误差。（ii）LLMs通常能捕捉因果关联性，但无法可靠地识别直接性或方向性。（iii）相对而言，基于logit的置信度提供了最可靠的校准信号，而跨模型一致性在直接边预测中表现不佳。
tldr: 本文系统评估了12个开源LLM在因果边判断中的可靠性，发现它们倾向于过度预测因果边、难以区分直接性与方向性，且基于logit的置信度是最可靠的校准信号。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates 12 open-weight LLMs for causal-edge judgments, finding they tend to overpredict edges, struggle with directness and orientation, and logit-based confidence offers the most reliable calibration signal.
